fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of the "cloudflared" tool with the tunnel "cleanup" flag in order to cleanup tunnel connections.
fields.name: Cloudflared Tunnel Connections Cleanup
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains " tunnel " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "cleanup ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "-config " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-connector-id ")))
